title: Choose byte alignment for observed LZ previews
changes: Allow a preserved byte offset into decoded LZ outputs for tile sheets, object animations and tilemap previews, with clear feedback for invalid offsets.
Retain trailing decoded bytes so unaligned word reads and incomplete tiles are represented without losing source data.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-lz-alignment-synthetic-455fmpyn passed 75 decoder, browser and regression checks, including unaligned tails and incomplete 8-bit tiles.

Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-lz-alignment-recovered-ih3l6kex matched the complete catalog hash and 28 source ranges; Chrome checked 73595 shifted words and 150 tile-depth previews across 25 streams.
The same unit matched all 12 Docker/Python output files; two validated ignored local wiki pages were published with guarded preimages.
limitations: Tile depth, offset, graphics meaning and palettes remain manually interpreted; live scene composition, other previews/audio and native Windows remain open.
